title: Fishdle Release: 5 months of solo dev <3 - F2P fishing MMO
author: malboyoo
selftext:
Hey !

👉 **Play in browser:** [https://fishdle.online/play?guest](https://fishdle.online/play?guest)

👉 **Join the Discord:** [https://discord.gg/2u5q64X3GK](https://discord.gg/2u5q64X3GK)

I’ve been building Fishdle solo for the past 5 months. It's a persistent browser fishing game that balances casual idle progression with active gameplay when you want to dive in

After a few weeks of public playtesting, the game is officially launched (**October 30th**). We're doing one last fresh-start wipe for release and **there will be no more wipes after this** 🚀

**Here's the quick rundown:**

* **Progression & Gear:** Tweak your setups (rods, baits, hooks), manage active techniques, and jump into daily tournaments or territory battles.
* **Fishpedia & Cards:** Catch native species across different zones, build your card collection, and unlock permanent passive bonuses 🐟
* **Clubs & Quests:** Daily/weekly quests, dynamic wandering merchants, club-driven territory control, and 100+ achievements to complete.
* **Fresh for release:** A completely revamped UI, upgraded graphics for every zone with better water rendering, immersive ambient audio, and a brand-new endgame zone (Amazonia, lvl 60+).

It’s 100% **free-to-play** directly in your browser. You can jump in instantly as a guest to test the water without registering.

👉 **Play in browser:** [https://fishdle.online/play?guest](https://fishdle.online/play?guest)

👉 **Join the Discord:** [https://discord.gg/2u5q64X3GK](https://discord.gg/2u5q64X3GK)

*AI Disclosure: Since I'm a solo dev focused entirely game design and code architecture, I used AI tools to generate code, illustrations and visual assets.*
